meta.source: NYC OMB Capital Projects Dashboard, Citywide Budget and Schedule (data.cityofnewyork.us fb86-vt7u), every reporting period, fully paged

rules.collapse: one record per project per period, most advanced phase kept, first row wins a tie
rules.committed: sum of max(total_budget - spend_to_date, 0) over projects not excluded and not Close-out
rules.spend: growth in spend_to_date between consecutive periods on the matched panel (projects present in both), floored at zero per project, excluded projects skipped; Close-out kept
rules.ttm_spend: sum of the last three spend entries

meta.group_format: by_phase, by_agency, by_borough, by_category values are [unspent, project_count]; by_phase includes Close-out, the others exclude it
